resources.string: Iguqula izinkinobho zokuswayipha zerimothi ye-Beauty-R1 zibe okulandelayo, okwangaphambili, ivolumu nokudlala/ukumisa okwesikhashana.

Shizuku: %1$s
Isevisi yokubamba: %2$s
Okunye okufinyelelekayo: %3$s

Ngenkathi isevisi yokubamba isebenza, izinkinobho zokuqondisa zerimothi zisebenza ngaphandle kokubonisa ikhesa. Uma kungenjalo, okunye okufinyelelekayo kuyakuphatha, kodwa ikhesa isavela.

I-R1 BT Remote isebenzisa i-AccessibilityService API ye-Android njengenye indlela uma i-Shizuku ingasebenzi.

Kungani kudingeka: irimothi ye-Beauty-R1 izenza isikrini sokuthinta, ngakho konke ukucindezela inkinobho kufika njengokuswayipha noma ukuthepha okungelona iqiniso. Isevisi yokufinyeleleka ibamba lokhu okokufaka kwesikhombi, kanye nokucindezela kwesobunxele/kwesokudla okubanjiwe kwerimothi, ikuguqule kube izilawuli zemidiya: dlala/misa isikhashana, ithrekhi elandelayo neyangaphambilini, ukuya phambili ngokushesha, ukubuyisela emuva kanye nevolumu.

Ngesikhathi ivuliwe, okokufaka kwesikhombi semawusi kuya kusevisi esikhundleni sokuya kwamanye ama-app. Isevisi ayifundi okuqukethwe kwesikrini noma lokho okuthayiphayo, futhi i-app ayiqoqi, ayigcini noma yabelane nganoma iyiphi idatha.

Thepha okuthi Ngiyavuma ukuze uvule amasethingi okufinyeleleka e-Android, lapho ungavula khona i-R1 BT Remote. Ungayivala lapho nganoma isiphi isikhathi.
